body.statement: For an ADMG \(\mathcal G\) on \(V\), whenever the ordinary \(\operatorname{ID}\) algorithm returns an observed-law expression \(E_{\mathrm{ID}}\) for \(P(Y=y\mid\operatorname{do}(X=x))\), every causal model \(M\) represented by \(\mathcal G\) satisfies \(E_{\mathrm{ID}}(P_M(V))=q(M)\).

attestation.note: The soundness claim was checked against Theorem 38 in the cited JMLR article.
